name: MariaDB
subtitle: Community fork of MySQL (SQL)
creator: Michael "Monty" Widenius (MySQL's co-creator)
description: A drop-in replacement for MySQL created after Oracle bought MySQL, led by one of MySQL's original authors. Many Linux distributions ship it as their default MySQL-compatible database.

concepts.explanation: InnoDB plus extras like Aria and ColumnStore.
Query data as it was in the past.

codeSamples.label: SQL
codeSamples.code:
CREATE TABLE posts (
  id         INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  title      VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  published  BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
) WITH SYSTEM VERSIONING;   -- keeps history of every change

SELECT * FROM posts FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF '2026-01-01';

cons: Company behind it went through financial turmoil

pricing.summary: Free and open source. Managed options on AWS, DigitalOcean and others.
